title: d/control: Enable build of all packages for riscv64
commit_message: d/control: Enable build of all packages for riscv64
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 6cfb633..cabc293 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+ubuntu-meta (1.473) impish; urgency=medium
+
+  * Enabled build of ubuntu-desktop/ubuntu-desktop-minimal for riscv64
+
+ -- Alexandre Ghiti <alexandre.ghiti@canonical.com>  Wed, 06 Oct 2021 09:49:16 +0200
+
 ubuntu-meta (1.472) impish; urgency=medium
 
   * Refreshed dependencies
diff --git a/debian/control b/debian/control
index 071399d..422e24c 100644
--- a/debian/control
+++ b/debian/control
@@ -36,7 +36,7 @@ Description: The Ubuntu standard system
  it not be removed.
 
 Package: ubuntu-desktop-minimal
-Architecture: amd64 arm64 armhf ppc64el
+Architecture: amd64 arm64 armhf ppc64el riscv64
 Depends: ${misc:Depends}, ${germinate:Depends}
 Recommends: ${germinate:Recommends}
 Provides: packagekit-installer
@@ -58,7 +58,7 @@ Description: The Ubuntu desktop system for Raspberry Pi
  it not be removed.
 
 Package: ubuntu-desktop
-Architecture: amd64 arm64 armhf ppc64el
+Architecture: amd64 arm64 armhf ppc64el riscv64
 Depends: ${misc:Depends}, ${germinate:Depends}
 Recommends: ${germinate:Recommends}
 Provides: packagekit-installer
